entities.name: Marta Sánchez Salfrán
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Marta Sánchez Salfrán is a Cuban former volleyball player and two-time Olympian who helped Cuba win a gold medal at the 2000 Summer Olympics and a bronze medal at the 2004 Summer Olympics. She also won a gold medal at the 1995 Pan American Games and a silver medal at the 1999 and 2003 Pan American Games.
